interactions.summary: Concurrent use may increase the anticoagulant effect of warfarin and increase bleeding risk.
interactions.mechanism: Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole may increase warfarin exposure and anticoagulant effect.
interactions.recommended_action: Flag for qualified clinician or pharmacist review.
